text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Japanese Oaks. Spectators' expectations are running high thanks to Hishi Amazon's strong performance at the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Similarly, Narita Brian crushed the Satsuki Sho, winning the first leg of the Triple Crown. Hishi Amazon is extra pumped—she can't back down here.
